scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=extension
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@stars-manager/shared && npm run build --workspace=@stars-manager/core && npm run build --workspace=@stars-manager/storage-node
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=extension
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.yml
